verdict.rationale: Orb's docs clearly show subscription creation via API (orb-docs-8) and update-type operations like Subscription Edits and plan changes with proration, all API-capable (orb-docs-10, orb-docs-31, orb-docs-16). However, no evidence explicitly documents 'pause' or 'cancel' subscription endpoints/actions, so the full lifecycle claim is only partially substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pause and cancel subscription API operations, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of full lifecycle API-only usage.
